payload.acceptance_criteria:
WHEN orch lesson close names a change that is not a commit on the main branch, THE COMMAND SHALL refuse it by name and append no event.
WHEN orch lesson close names a commit on the main branch, THE COMMAND SHALL append one close event that carries that commit.
A test in tests/ proves both cases.
